title: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate?
question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    s.StreetAbr,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailZip,
    s.MailState
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY CAST(st.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / st.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM "schools"

LIMIT 1
